title: jig project config
description: .jig/config.jsonc (in git) and .jig/config.local.jsonc (outside git, laid over it: objects merge by key, checks by name, other values replace). jig reads only these files; nothing outside them runs.

rules.description: jig's own rules. Suppression directives are always denied; these levels set the gates for new comments, new test cases and open todo items at the end of a turn (default error for all).

jig/todos.description: End of turn: block once while the agent's todo list has an item neither completed nor starting with skip: or n/a:, or a /jig turn has no todo list

agent-view.description: Proof of UI changes in the running app, read by jig pre-mr

checks.description: The project's own checks, run after an edit or at the end of a turn on the matching files.

name.description: Unique; findings use the rule check/<name>

files.description: Glob or globs, repo-relative with forward slashes

run.description: Command without a shell; the token {files} becomes one argument per file

format.description: exit: a non-zero exit is one finding; jsonl: jig finding lines; a tool name: that tool's output parser

seedExclude.description: Globs (repo-relative, forward slashes) that jig worktree seed skips

copyFiles.description: Files inside fully ignored folders that jig worktree seed copies as well

tool.description: A catalog tool or proof by name. {} turns it on, false turns it off; a name missing from the config never runs.

command.description: Replaces the catalog command, e.g. vue-tsc for tsc

ignoreRules.description: Rule globs whose findings are dropped, e.g. boundaries/*
